answer: Each identity files one violet-stamped survey in the gale-season census: one glacier plot with its melt line, key-signed, bonded for 70. Gale auditors replay the census each epoch; a copied survey or reused stamp burns the bond. First costs 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. A rented ring fails: each survey needs a fresh glacier plot and key. An honest agent files once for 38, keeps its bond.
